items.title: nexu-io/opengame
items.why: It connects AI agents with game development, showing how multiple coding agents can work together on software projects.
items.summary: OpenGame is an open-source engine that connects over 20 AI coding agents together to help developers generate and publish custom games.

items.title: qianyiai/KuroCat
items.why: It is a fun open-source desktop tool that combines modern frontend tech with AI coding assistant integrations.
items.summary: KuroCat is an open-source 3D desktop cat companion built with Rust and Tauri that integrates with AI models like Claude and DeepSeek to assist while coding.

items.title: Launch HN: Versine (YC F26) – MCP to send and receive money
items.why: It highlights how startups are building dedicated developer infrastructure specifically designed for autonomous AI agents.
items.summary: Versine is a Y Combinator-backed project providing a standardized server interface for AI agents to send and request payments programmatically.

items.title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
items.why: It shows a practical way to use AI coding agents to optimize performance in projects you build.
items.summary: Fast-Anything helps you profile slow parts of Python, Node, or Ruby applications and use AI coding agents to rewrite just those bottleneck functions in high-performance Rust.

items.title: sybil-solutions/skill-distill
items.why: It touches on an active area in open-source AI: helping free, open-weight models match the coding skill of proprietary tools.
items.summary: Skill-Distill captures coding patterns from proprietary AI assistants like Claude Code and packages them into instruction sets that open-source models can follow.

items.title: 1Password Security Incident
items.why: 1Password is standard security tooling across tech companies, making security disclosures relevant to developers.
items.summary: Password management provider 1Password reported a security incident, prompting widespread discussion on security practices across developer communities.

items.title: Porting Rockbox to an undocumented $9 Aliexpress 'YP3' MP3 Player with LLMs
items.why: It demonstrates how you can use LLMs as interactive tutors to tackle challenging low-level programming tasks.
items.summary: A developer shares how they used LLMs to guide them through reverse-engineering a cheap hardware player and writing low-level software for it.

items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
items.why: Setting up your own server is great CS practice, and AI tools make troubleshooting complex infrastructure much easier.
items.summary: Developers discuss how using LLMs to write configuration files and explain setup steps makes building home servers far less intimidating for beginners.

items.title: Google Will Make AI Agents Use Its MCP Servers. The Gmail One Can't Send Email
items.why: MCP is rapidly becoming an industry standard for connecting AI agents to external applications and tools.
items.summary: Google is integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into its ecosystem to let AI agents safely interact with services like Gmail.

items.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
items.why: It covers major tech policy news intersecting space exploration, data center infrastructure, and regulatory approval.
items.summary: The US FCC approved SpaceX plans to launch satellites intended for orbital data processing, despite skepticism raised by scientific organizations.

items.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
items.why: It keeps you informed on a major global public health emergency currently unfolding.
items.summary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases while regional conflict hampers international medical aid response.
